note: Visible tests cover plain sums; hidden tests cover unit order, the fraction rule, half-up rounding and the sign.

twin_breaks.rule: Components appear in strictly descending unit order
with exactly one space between them
Only the last component may have a fraction
A fraction has digits on both sides of the point
Exact halves round away from zero
One leading `-` negates the whole duration
The units are `w` (7 days), `d` (24 hours), `h`, `m` (minutes), `s` and `ms`
